notes: Bare "when P, Q" with indefinite participants correctly takes the whenever rule form (Skolem consequent + During, no QuantifierPhrase); roles follow the tests (inanimate transitive subject Agent, unchanged object Theme) and "at night" is the licensed day-part Time symbol. Individuating the mist-light as a premise variable is what lets the anaphoric definite "the mist-light" bind in the consequent.
